messages.content: You are a helpful customer service agent. Answer questions based only on the provided company information.

<company_info>

Return Policy: All products may be returned within 30 days of purchase with original receipt.
Items must be in original, unused condition. Final sale items are non-returnable.
Electronics have a 15-day return window. Hazardous materials cannot be returned.

</company_info>

Customer question: Can I return a laptop I bought 20 days ago? It's been opened and used.

message.content: No. Laptops are electronics, so they have a 15-day return window, and yours was purchased 20 days ago. Also, returns must be in original, unused condition, so an opened and used laptop wouldn’t qualify.
